Read input: rtlpp_08600_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_08600 (
    address,
    chipselect,
    clk,
    reset_n,
    write_n,
    writedata,
    out_port,
    readdata
);

  output           out_port;
  output  [31:0]   readdata;
  input   [1:0]    address;
  input            chipselect;
  input            clk;
  input            reset_n;
  input            write_n;
  input   [31:0]   writedata;

  reg              data_out;
  wire             read_mux_out;

  always @(posedge clk or negedge reset_n) begin
    if (~reset_n)
      data_out <= 0;
    else if (chipselect && ~write_n && (address == 0))
      data_out <= writedata[0];
  end

  assign read_mux_out = (address == 0) ? data_out : 1'b0;
  assign readdata = {31'b0, read_mux_out};
  assign out_port = data_out;

endmodule
